snippet.title: Yoo Ninja Free - Full Game Walkthrough No Commentary
snippet.description:
Yoo ninja is an old iconic android game that people used to play when they were a kid. after 2016 the game was removed from both Play store and App store for unknown reason. 
NOTE: This game only works on Android 10 or below. if you have Android 11 it won't work and will show black screen
